bee.v1.PostAttachment.description:
Something in the post's repo that the post is about, with what a client needs to show it as
a card. A writer sets `kind` and `id` (or, for a change request or an issue, `number`); the
server checks it and fills the rest on every read from the attachment as it is now. When the
attachment is gone (or a release went back to draft) only `kind` and `id` are set.

state.description:
The attachment's state in lower case: `open`, `landed` or `closed` for a change request,
`open` or `closed` for an issue, `published` or `prerelease` for a release, and the
AgentRunState name without its prefix (`running`, `succeeded`, ...) for an agent run.

title.description:
A release's name (else its tag); the first line of an agent run's prompt (else its agent's
name).
